image_description: A European fire salamander (Salamandra salamandra) is shown in a natural forest floor setting, resting among brown fallen leaves, moss, and decaying wood. The salamander has a glossy black body with vivid yellow spots and stripes. Its head is visible with small dark eyes, and its body curves through the leaf litter. The tail extends toward the right side of the frame. The environment appears moist and natural, consistent with the salamander's typical habitat.
